annotations.title: Play a video on the TV

description: Play a video on the TV in full screen inside TeleQ. Works with direct video files (.mp4, .webm, .mkv) and HLS (.m3u8) or DASH (.mpd) streams over public https://. For YouTube, Rutube, VK Video, Netflix and other services use open_in_app instead. Use `playback` afterwards to pause, resume or seek.

title.description: Optional title shown on the TV (up to 120 characters).

url.description: Public https:// URL of the video file or stream.
